items.title: Pregnant woman among more than 10 killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza

sentences.en: Pregnant woman among more than 10 killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza.
sentences.zh: 10多名孕妇在以色列对加沙的袭击中丧生。

sentences.en: Woman’s family says she died of injuries after being shot in the head while sitting inside a tent near Khan Younis A pregnant Palestinian woman died on Saturday from injuries sustained after being shot in the head by Israeli forces south of Khan Younis, according to her family and medical workers, as strikes across Gaza killed at least 10 people in 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 该女子的家人说，她坐在汗尤尼斯附近的一个帐篷里，头部中弹身亡。据她的家人和医务人员称，一名怀孕的巴勒斯坦妇女星期六在汗尤尼斯以南被以色列军队击中头部后受伤身亡，因为加沙各地的罢工在48小时内造成至少10人死亡。

sentences.en: The woman, named as Iman Shalouf, 27, who was nearly eight months pregnant, was sitting inside her family’s tent in the al-Mawasi area when Israeli gunfire struck her, according to paramedics and witnesses.
sentences.zh: 据医护人员和目击者称，这名名为Iman Shalouf的女子， 27岁，怀孕近8个月，在以色列枪声袭击她时，她正坐在al-Mawasi地区她家的帐篷里。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: US congressman swims to safety after his plane is forced to land on a lake

sentences.en: US congressman swims to safety after his plane is forced to land on a lake.
sentences.zh: 美国国会议员在飞机被迫降落在湖上后，游到安全的地方。

sentences.en: The small plane carrying Rep Tom Tiffany had a mechanical issue that forced the pilot to make an emergency landing on a Wisconsin lake.
sentences.zh: 搭载众议员汤姆·蒂芙尼（ Tom Tiffany ）的小型飞机发生机械故障，迫使飞行员紧急降落在威斯康星州的一个湖泊上。

items.title: Turkish police detain dozens in raids on gay bars and homes of LGBTQ+ activists

sentences.en: Turkish police detain dozens in raids on gay bars and homes of LGBTQ+ activists.
sentences.zh: 土耳其警方在突袭LGBTQ +活动人士的同性恋酒吧和住宅时拘留了数十人。

sentences.en: Human rights groups in Turkey have accused the government of using a family- values campaign to target the LGBTQ+ community.
sentences.zh: 土耳其的人权组织指责政府利用家庭价值观运动针对LGBTQ +社区。

items.title: Legendary Canadian boxer George Chuvalo dies aged 89

sentences.en: Legendary Canadian boxer George Chuvalo dies aged 89.
sentences.zh: 加拿大传奇拳击手乔治·丘瓦洛去世，享年89岁。

sentences.en: The heavyweight champion took on the likes of Muhammad Ali and Joe Frazier, and was known for never once getting knocked out or knocked down.
sentences.zh: 这位重量级冠军与穆罕默德·阿里（ Muhammad Ali ）和乔·弗雷泽（ Joe Frazier ）相提并论，以从未被击倒或击倒而闻名。

items.title: Actor Tatyana Ali is advocating for Black and Indigenous maternal health

sentences.en: Actor Tatyana Ali is advocating for Black and Indigenous maternal health.
sentences.zh: 演员塔蒂亚娜·阿里（ Tatyana Ali ）倡导黑人和土著孕产妇保健。

sentences.en: Actor Tatyana Ali says her healing journey after a traumatic childbirth has inspired her advocacy for Black maternal health, including support for midwives, doulas and other birth workers.
sentences.zh: 演员塔蒂亚娜·阿里（ Tatyana Ali ）说，她在创伤性分娩后的康复之旅激发了她对黑人孕产妇保健的倡导，包括对助产士、杜拉和其他分娩工人的支持。

sentences.en: (Image credit: Manfred Baumann)
sentences.zh: （图片来源： Manfred Baumann ）

items.title: Six dead, 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes in Java Sea

sentences.en: Six dead, 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes in Java Sea.
sentences.zh: 印度尼西亚渡轮在爪哇海倾覆后造成6人死亡， 130人失踪。

sentences.en: Ships and helicopters are searching for those missing from the Virgo Transport 8 ship, which had encountered bad weather.
sentences.zh: 船只和直升机正在寻找遭遇恶劣天气的处女座运输8号船上的失踪人员。

items.title: At least six dead and 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes, officials say

sentences.en: At least six dead and 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes, officials say.
sentences.zh: 官员说，在印度尼西亚渡轮倾覆后，至少有6人死亡， 130人失踪。

sentences.en: Search and rescue agency says 107 people brought to safety from vessel hit by bad weather in Java Sea Rescue workers in Indonesia said at least six people had died and 130 others were missing on Sunday after a ferry sailing between the islands of Java and Borneo capsized in bad weather.
sentences.zh: 搜索和救援机构表示，印度尼西亚爪哇岛海上救援人员遭遇恶劣天气的船只撞击后，有107人安全返回，周日，一艘在爪哇岛和婆罗洲岛之间航行的渡轮在恶劣天气下倾覆，造成至少6人死亡， 130人失踪。

sentences.en: Basarnas, Indonesia’s national search and rescue agency, said 107 people had been rescued from the Virgo ⁠Transport 8 vessel, which set sail on Saturday with 243 ​people onboard, including 30 crew members, ​from ‌the East Java ‌city of Surabaya.
sentences.zh: 印度尼西亚国家搜救机构巴萨纳斯（ Basarnas ）表示，从东爪哇泗水（ Surabaya ）市起航的处女座运输8号（ Virgo⁠Transport 8 ）船上有107人获救，船上有243人，其中包括30名船员。

items.title: Politics chat: Trump's $5,000 promise to voters, Vance invokes Charlie Kirk

sentences.en: Politics chat: Trump's $5,000 promise to voters, Vance invokes Charlie Kirk.
sentences.zh: 政治聊天：特朗普对选民的5000 $承诺，万斯援引查理柯克。

sentences.en: Following the midterm convention in Dallas, President Trump's $5,000 campaign promise has generated attention, but not belief.
sentences.zh: 在达拉斯举行的中期大会之后，特朗普总统的5000 $竞选承诺引起了人们的关注，但不是信念。

sentences.en: And, Vice President JD Vance characterizes Democrats as extremists.
sentences.zh: 而且，副总统JD Vance将民主党人定性为极端主义者。

items.title: From fracking to data centers: Hearing from people on both sides of the opposition

sentences.en: From fracking to data centers: Hearing from people on both sides of the opposition.
sentences.zh: 从水力压裂到数据中心：听取反对派双方人士的意见。

sentences.en: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe speaks with environmentalist, Bill McKibben, and public relations specialist, Frank Maisano, about opposition to industrial development projects like fracking and data centers.
sentences.zh: NPR的Ayesha Rascoe与环保主义者Bill McKibben和公共关系专家Frank Maisano谈到反对水力压裂和数据中心等工业发展项目。

items.title: Pressure builds in Spain to deny US extradition request for leftwing donor

sentences.en: Pressure builds in Spain to deny US extradition request for leftwing donor.
sentences.zh: 在西班牙，拒绝美国对左翼捐赠者的引渡请求的压力越来越大。

sentences.en: Key government meeting this month will consider US bid to try James ‘Fergie’ Chambers over alleged support for Hamas Attorneys for James “Fergie” Chambers, the US citizen and wealthy donor to leftwing and humanitarian projects worldwide who is currently imprisoned in Madrid and sought in extradition, have submitted a brief ahead of a decisive government meeting on the case.
sentences.zh: 本月的关键政府会议将考虑美国申请审判詹姆斯· “弗吉” ·钱伯斯（ James ‘Fergie’ Chambers ） ，因为他涉嫌支持詹姆斯· “弗吉” ·钱伯斯（ James “Fergie” Chambers ）的哈马斯律师，詹姆斯· “弗吉” ·钱伯斯（ James “Fergie” Chambers ）是美国公民，也是全球左翼和人道主义项目的富裕捐助者，目前被关押在马德里并被要求引渡，他在政府就此案

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Chambers’ partner, the actor and activist Stella Schnabel, met last week with multiple members of the Spanish parliament to assert his innocence.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，钱伯斯的合伙人、演员兼活动家斯特拉·施纳贝尔（ Stella Schnabel ）上周会见了西班牙议会的多名成员，声称自己是无辜的。

items.title: Married at 13, pregnant and starving: Child brides of Yemen

sentences.en: Married at 13, pregnant and starving: Child brides of Yemen.
sentences.zh: 13岁结婚，怀孕和挨饿：也门的儿童新娘。

sentences.en: Fatimah* was 13 when she was married off to an older man.
sentences.zh: 法蒂玛* 13岁时嫁给了一个年长的男人。

sentences.en: Two years later, she gave birth to twin daughters.
sentences.zh: 两年后，她生下了双胞胎女儿。

items.title: Guterres: Old global order must change as power shifts to emerging economies

sentences.en: Guterres: Old global order must change as power shifts to emerging economies.
sentences.zh: 古特雷斯：随着权力向新兴经济体转移，旧的全球秩序必须改变。

sentences.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres told leaders of a bloc of major emerging economies in New Delhi on Sunday that a more balanced global order requires an overhaul of the institutions built after the Second World War, including the UN Security Council.
sentences.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯（ António Guterres ）周日在新德里对一个主要新兴经济体集团的领导人表示，一个更加平衡的全球秩序需要对第二次世界大战后建立的机构进行彻底改革，包括联合国安理会。

items.title: Houthis claim attack on Saudi base as fighting flares with Yemeni forces

sentences.en: Houthis claim attack on Saudi base as fighting flares with Yemeni forces.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装声称在与也门军队作战时袭击了沙特基地。

sentences.en: Iran-allied Houthis say drones and missiles used in attack that targeted ‘weapons depots and command and control centres’ in southern Saudi Arabia Houthi fighters have said they used drones and missiles to attack a military base in southern Saudi Arabia, as Yemen’s Riyadh-backed government described the rebels’ swift advance along the Red Sea coast as a “painful” development in a new front in the Iran war.
sentences.zh: 与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装表示，在袭击沙特阿拉伯南部胡塞武装分子的“武器库和指挥控制中心”时使用的无人机和导弹表示，他们使用无人机和导弹袭击沙特阿拉伯南部的一个军事基地，因为也门利雅得支持的政府将叛乱分子在红海沿岸的迅速推进描述为伊朗战争新战线的“痛苦”发展。

sentences.en: The UN said on Sunday that nearly 86,000 people had fled Yemen, most of them since early September when the Iran-backed Houthi rebels launched a large-scale offensive that last week resulted in the capture of a key port city and an island on the Bab al-Mandab strait, a crucial shipping alternative to the strait of Hormuz.
sentences.zh: 联合国周日表示，近86,000人逃离也门，其中大多数人是自9月初以来逃离的，当时伊朗支持的胡塞叛乱分子发动了大规模攻势，上周占领了Bab al-Mandab海峡的一个主要港口城市和一个岛屿，这是霍尔木兹海峡的重要航运替代品。

sentences.zh: 伊朗战争重塑了金砖国家的关系，但也暴露了分歧。

sentences.en: Brics members agree they need a new global order but it's harder to answer what should replace it and how to get there.
sentences.zh: 金砖国家成员同意他们需要一个新的全球秩序，但很难回答应该用什么来取代它，以及如何实现这一目标。

items.title: Can you imagine a universe without a new 'Star Trek' on the horizon?

sentences.en: Can you imagine a universe without a new 'Star Trek' on the horizon?.
sentences.zh: 你能想象一个没有新的“星际迷航”即将到来的宇宙吗？

sentences.zh: 奇异新世界的明星安森·芒特（ Anson Mount ）说： “它的观众正在变老。”

items.title: Indonesian passenger ship overturns, sparking search for at least 129 missing

sentences.en: Indonesian passenger ship overturns, sparking search for at least 129 missing.
sentences.zh: 印度尼西亚客船倾覆，引发至少129人失踪的搜索。

sentences.en: Indonesian rescuers said about 130 passengers and crew are missing after a ferry carrying more than 240 people sank in bad weather in the Java Sea on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 印度尼西亚救援人员表示，周日在爪哇海一艘载有240多人的渡轮在恶劣天气中沉没后，约有130名乘客和机组人员失踪。

items.title: How a young woman was recruited to ISIS — and how she eventually escaped

sentences.en: How a young woman was recruited to ISIS — and how she eventually escaped.
sentences.zh: 一名年轻女子如何被招募到伊斯兰国—以及她最终如何逃脱。

sentences.en: A young Canadian mother shares her memories of being an ISIS bride, and her harrowing escape from the extremist group.
sentences.zh: 一位年轻的加拿大母亲分享了她作为ISIS新娘的记忆，以及她从极端主义团体中痛苦的逃脱。

items.title: One dead and more than 30 missing after ferry sinks off Vanuatu coast in rough seas

sentences.en: One dead and more than 30 missing after ferry sinks off Vanuatu coast in rough seas.
sentences.zh: 渡轮在瓦努阿图海岸的波涛汹涌的海面上沉没，造成一人死亡， 30多人失踪。

sentences.en: Prime minister’s office tells families of those missing ‘the nation stands with you’ as search and rescue efforts continue One person has died and more than 30 are missing after a ferry sank off the coast of Vanuatu, the country’s government says.
sentences.zh: 瓦努阿图政府表示，总理办公室告诉失踪人员的家属“国家与你站在一起” ，因为搜索和救援工作仍在继续。瓦努阿图沿海的一艘渡轮沉没后，一人死亡， 30多人失踪。

sentences.en: The vessel, MV Matui, had set sail with more than 40 passengers and crew on Friday from the island of Santo to Ambae island in very rough seas, but did not arrive.
sentences.zh: 周五，这艘名为MV Matui的船只载着40多名乘客和船员，在非常波涛汹涌的海面上从圣托岛驶往安贝岛，但没有到达。

sentences.en: They lost their jobs after posting about Charlie Kirk, but some have no regrets.
sentences.zh: 他们在发布有关查理·柯克的帖子后失去了工作，但有些人并不后悔。

sentences.en: Some people fired in the wake of Kirk's assassination have won big settlements from employers, others have had to start over from scratch.
sentences.zh: 柯克遇刺后被解雇的一些人赢得了雇主的大笔和解，其他人不得不从头开始。

items.title: Russians seek answers over hundreds missing after Ukraine's 2024 incursion

sentences.en: Russians seek answers over hundreds missing after Ukraine's 2024 incursion.
sentences.zh: 在乌克兰2024年入侵后，俄罗斯人寻找数百名失踪者的答案。

sentences.en: Officials say more than 300 Russians remain missing after the 2024 Kursk offensive, but no-one really knows the true figure.
sentences.zh: 官员们表示， 2024年库尔斯克攻势后，仍有300多名俄罗斯人失踪，但没有人真正知道真实数字。

items.title: Afghan woman deported from US in first use of 'alien terrorist' court

sentences.en: Afghan woman deported from US in first use of 'alien terrorist' court.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗妇女在首次使用“外国恐怖分子”法庭时被驱逐出美国。

sentences.en: The legal US resident was never charged with a crime, but was deported due to her family links to terrorism.
sentences.zh: 这位合法的美国居民从未被指控犯罪，但由于她的家庭与恐怖主义有联系而被驱逐出境。
